source: Editorial task: help swimmers use the temporary pool entrance. The east entrance is closed for repairs for ten days. Swimmers use the west entrance and keep their existing tickets. The facilities team will separately consider maintenance spending; this notice is not that review.

idea.title: Using the west entrance during pool repairs
idea.description: Evaluate whether the facilities team should increase maintenance spending.
idea.rationale: The notice helps swimmers enter while the east door is closed.
idea.evidence: East entrance closed ten days; existing tickets remain valid.
